name: Morimura Sakuya
source:
Morimura is a kind-hearted honor student. He's the only son of a doctor, but as he is interested in plants, he wants to become a botanist. His way of thinking and plans for the future bring him into conflict with his father, and his mother doesn't live with them. He's very knowledgeable on many subjects, and he often offers explanations on physics. His hobby is playing video games and is friendly with many people, including Reiichi Himuro and Ikkaku Amanohashi. He loves video games.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tokimeki_Memorial_Girl%27s_Side]Wikipedia[/url]]
